map.工具给出三选一：①缩短单件讲解至 ⌊(单件×可用−移动−开场)÷件数⌋ 秒；②减: The tool offers three options: 1) shorten the per-item narration to floor((per-item x available - movement - opening) / items) seconds; 2) cut the narrated exhibits to floor((available - opening) / (per-item + movement)) items; 3) compress movement time. Cut redundant exhibits and movement gaps first, and keep the highlights.

map.按展品数、单件讲解、移动与开场结束时间估算导览总时长，并与观众可用时间对比；超时: Estimate total guide duration from exhibit count, per-exhibit narration, walking time and opening/closing remarks, then compare it with available visitor time. Overtime shows a negative difference; blank, negative or fractional inputs are rejected instead of being truncated and used.
map.快速模式用“展品数×单件讲解＋移动段数×单段移动＋开场结束”求总秒数，再与可用分: Quick mode computes exhibit count × per-exhibit narration + walking segments × walking time + opening/closing time, then compares it with available minutes × 60. Exhibit count must be an integer ≥ 1; narration, walking and opening/closing must be non-negative integer seconds; available time must exceed 0. Any missing or out-of-range field shows only a correction prompt. Detail mode sums actual per-exhibit seconds and shows share and cumulative time.
map.团队讲解前快速判断 30 件展品、每件 90 秒是否能在 90 分钟内完成。: Before a group tour, check whether 30 exhibits at 90 seconds each fit within 90 minutes.
map.逐件编排重点馆讲解，查看哪一件占用了最多时间。: Plan narration exhibit by exhibit and see which one takes the most time.
map.超时后按建议缩短单件、减少件数或压缩移动时间。: After overtime, shorten each stop, reduce the number of exhibits or compress walking time as suggested.
map.快速模式填写展品数、单件讲解、移动、开场结束与可用时间。: In quick mode, enter exhibit count, per-exhibit narration, walking time, opening/closing time and available time.
map.超时时阅读三条调整建议；需要逐件核算时切到明细模式。: Read the three adjustment options when overtime occurs; switch to detail mode for exhibit-by-exhibit calculation.
map.明细模式逐行填写展品名与整数秒数，再对比可用时间。: In detail mode, enter each exhibit name and integer seconds, then compare with available time.
map.同样参数但可用 10 分钟：时间差显示 −180 秒，不再用无符号的“180 秒: Same inputs but 10 minutes available: the difference shows −180 seconds, so overtime is not confused with remaining time.
map.展品数填 2.5 或留空：工具提示必须为 ≥1 的整数，不计算总时长。: Entering 2.5 or leaving exhibit count blank: the tool requires an integer ≥ 1 and does not calculate.
map.估算只覆盖讲解、移动与开场结束，不含排队、互动、拍照和临时停留。时间差为正表示剩: The estimate covers narration, walking and opening/closing only, not queues, interaction, photos or spontaneous stops. A positive difference is remaining time, a negative one is overtime; detail-mode durations must also be non-negative integer seconds or no result is produced.
map.优先缩短单件讲解至可用时间扣除移动与开场后的均值，其次减少讲解展品数，最后压缩移: First shorten per-exhibit narration to the average left after walking and opening/closing, then reduce the number of narrated exhibits, and finally compress walking time; keep the key halls.
map.时间差前面的负号是什么意思？: What does the minus sign before the time difference mean?
map.负号表示总时长超过可用时间，例如 −180 秒就是超时 3 分钟；正号表示还有剩: A minus sign means the total exceeds available time; −180 seconds is three minutes overtime. A plus sign means time remains.
map.为什么空值或小数不出结果？: Why do blank or fractional inputs produce no result?
map.空值不再当作 0，小数也不再被 parseInt 截断；工具要求展品数为 ≥1: Blank values are no longer treated as zero and fractions are no longer truncated by parseInt. Exhibit count must be an integer ≥ 1 and the other durations non-negative integers, so bad inputs cannot produce a plausible-looking schedule.
map.它是可用秒数除以展品数的下限值；某件远高于均值时优先压缩它，明细视图还能看到占比: It is the floor of available seconds divided by exhibit count. If one exhibit is far above average, shorten it first; detail view also shows share and cumulative time.
map.每件可用 = ⌊(可用秒−移动−开场)÷展品数⌋，不足 0 取 0，用于快速判断: Available time per item = floor((available seconds − walking − opening) / number of items), floored at 0, which gives a quick read on whether the current per-item setting overruns. If one item far exceeds the average, compress it first. The per-item view also shows each item share and cumulative time, making it easy to trim precisely.
map.：某团队 5 件展品、单件讲解 120 秒、移动 30 秒/段、开场结束 60: : a team has 5 exhibits, 120 s of narration per item, 30 s of movement per leg and 60 s of opening and closing, with 20 minutes available. Total = 5 x 120 + 4 x 30 + 60 = 780 s (13 minutes); available 20 x 60 = 1200 s; the difference is +420 s (7 minutes of slack); available per item = floor((1200 − 4×30 − 60) / 5) = 204 s. Per-item scenario: bronze ding 120 / chime bells 150 / jade bi 90 / terracotta warriors 100 / gold and silver ware 110, totalling 570 s, which against 10 minutes available (600 s) leaves only 30 s, so per-item time must be compressed or items removed.
map.点击“计算”，查看总时长、可用时间、带正负号的时间差与每件可用时长。: Click “Calculate” to see total duration, available time, the signed difference and available time per exhibit.
map.5 件、单件 120 秒、移动 30 秒/段、开场结束 60 秒、可用 20 分: 5 exhibits at 120 seconds, walking 30 seconds per segment, opening/closing 60 seconds, available 20 minutes: total 780 seconds, difference +420 seconds, 204 seconds available per exhibit.
map.每件可用时长怎么用？: How should I use available time per exhibit?
map.它是可用秒数扣除移动与开场后除以展品数的下限值（不足 0 取 0）；某件远高于均: It is the floor of available seconds after subtracting walking and opening/closing, divided by exhibit count (minimum 0). If one exhibit is far above average, shorten it first; detail view also shows share and cumulative time.
